text:
Tess: Quick sync  we need a concise rollout play for the regional routing change. Key asks: shadow/dark-launch, small canaries, A/B gating, and a single emergency disable. Who owns pieces?

Omar: I'll take the flag + kill endpoint. Proposed id: `regional-route-lite`.

Jing: Canary plan: 15m dark-launch, 1% telemetry-only (30m), 5% NA (1h), 15% NA+EU (4h). Hold 15m between phases to watch tails. Manual approval needed for Dedicated.

Tess: Gates (draft): p99 delta <=25ms, error delta <=0.05%, cost delta <=7%, eval MRT drop <=0.5, semantic drift <=0.6.

Nate: I'll run the seeded A/B eval during 1% and 5% windows. If drift or MRT exceed thresholds we abort.

Omar: Flag YAML snippet:
```yaml
flag: regional-route-lite
phases:
  - mode: shadow
    duration: 900
  - mode: telemetry
    pct: 1
    duration: 1800
  - pct: 5
    regions: [NA]
    duration: 3600
  - pct: 15
    regions: [NA,EU]
    duration: 14400
kill_endpoint: /ops/flags/regional-route-lite/disable
metrics: [p99_latency,error_rate,unit_cost,eval_mrt,semantic_drift]
```

ops-bot: Infra check OK for NA/EU. Autoscaler headroom=20%. Auto-rollback configured for p99>40ms or error>0.1% or semantic_drift>0.6 or eval_mrt_drop>0.5.

Jing: Preflight: 10m warmup at 5qps; shadow-compare job; support FAQ.

Tess: Owners/ETAs:
- Omar: implement flag+kill (ETA: EOD)
- Nate: schedule evals (ETA: start with telemetry)
- Jing: runbook + preflight scripts (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Ops: alerts/dashboards (ETA: today)

Tess: Decision on automation: auto-up while gates pass up to 15%, manual for Dedicated or >15%. Locking this unless objections.

Omar: :thumbsup:

Nate: queued the eval harness.

Jing: drafting runbook now, will tag for review.

Tess: Thanks all, I'll add owners to the rollout card and request sign-offs.
